session_summary: Blue title bar: 'Bear Trend From The Open, Then Reversal Up'. A low 2 top at 5822 sell-the-close and minor parabolic wedge drop forms the day low 5745; higher low major trend reversal and breakout above the wedge launch a measuring move up with consecutive wedge tops to 5873, then the close sells back to the open for a doji day near 5810.
